$readme: THR-1253 — the guidance manifest. One entry per DOCTRINE: a body of direction whose
rules other surfaces restate, apply, or teach. Read Docs/plans/2026-08-25-thr-1253-guidance-governance.md.
Why it exists: rulings land in the canonical chain, but agents obey the OPERATIVE chain —
the prompts, briefs, exemplars and vault samples they load first. The 2026-08-25 prose-guidance
audit found three director-level register rulings sitting in canon while every operative surface
kept teaching the retired mode. This file makes the dependency explicit so a ruling PR cannot end
without disposing of every known restatement site.
FIELDS
version           Doctrine version. Bumping it is a deliberate act in the PR that changes the doctrine.
versionNote       Human note on what that version means and when it landed.
authorities       The surfaces that DEFINE the doctrine. Editing one of these arms the sweep gate.
dependents        Repo surfaces that restate or apply the doctrine. Editing one of these is free.
manualDependents  Out-of-repo surfaces (vault pages). Never gated — the /guidance-audit skill owns them.
THE GATE (npm run check:guidance-freshness) — a diff that touches an `authority` without
touching every `dependent` fails, naming the untouched ones, unless a commit body carries
`Guidance-sweep: <doctrineId> — <disposition>`. Advisory during burn-in; see GUIDANCE_GATE_MODE
in scripts/check-guidance-freshness.ts.
THE STAMP — dependents that carry YAML frontmatter declare `validated_doctrine: <id>@<version>`,
meaning someone re-read that surface against that doctrine version. One convention, deliberately:
a frontmatter key, never a suffix or comment marker. A dependent with NO frontmatter block (an
agent prompt template, a plain Docs page) is reported by the check as unstamped-by-shape — an
informational row, never a failure, and this change does not introduce frontmatter into a file
that lacks it, because a prompt template's bytes are read verbatim by an agent and adding a header
is a content edit wearing a stamp's clothes. Those surfaces are covered by the GATE, which does
cover every dependent. The stamp check is advisory ALWAYS — forcing it mechanically would recreate
the date-bump theater `last_validated_against` already demonstrated.
SCOPE — five doctrines: prose (the original, registered on demonstrated loss), the three
general-layer doctrines registered at THR-1331 (identity-vision, cosmology, coordination-process)
after the 2026-08-28 context audit found the unregistered general layer rotting — two finished
retirements unswept, every core rule in 3-4 drifting copies — and rules-of-play, registered at
THR-1343 (context-cleanup round 2) after the game-design audit found three retired eras live on
high-traffic surfaces. Adding a doctrine is a deliberate registration, not a default. This file
is small on purpose.
SUNSET — the gate, the stamps and the retro step enter the standing six-week sunset presumption
(CLAUDE.md § process-work throttle): renewed at retro by citing a catch, else deleted.

prose.versionNote: Prose doctrine v2 — narrator mode (GM narration). Landed 2026-08-25 via THR-1250/1251/1252; retires the pre-register 'scene-writer' aesthetic.

identity-vision.versionNote: Registered 2026-08-28 (THR-1331, context-cleanup round 1). The game is named Threadbearer (threadbearer.co) — director ruling 2026-08-28. Player = Ascendant. Nudge model: the god nudges odds with essence-priced cards, fate picks the outcome, mortals decide forks. Core loop: portfolio scan -> curated moment -> aftermath, 12 ticks/day.

cosmology.versionNote: Registered 2026-08-28 (THR-1331). Eight Reaches (Iron, Gold, Shadow, Veil, Heart, Eye, Stone, Star) x Twelve Spheres, orthogonal axes; Quintessence is a meta-property, not a ninth Reach. Nine-Reaches/Flesh retired 2026-03-28 (THR-307 sweep).

rules-of-play.versionNote: Registered 2026-08-28 (THR-1343, context-cleanup round 2). The rules of play as synthesised by the rulebook: nudge model (cards bend odds, fate rolls the five-band ladder, forks are the mortal's, player never picks an ending or sees a number), UnifiedActionTemplate single format, five verbs, three-beat turn at 12 ticks/day, five influence tiers with Aspect as the Apotheosis milestone, success-at-cost as dominant texture, 5% floor before cards. Round-2 audit found three retired eras (Godling/daily-tick, authored-choices, old pole names) live on high-traffic dependents; the sweep THR-1338..1342 cleared them.

coordination-process.versionNote: Registered 2026-08-28 (THR-1331). Single CC runtime (Codex retired THR-486, Cowork retired THR-654); design session vs execution session; vault filesystem-only via OBSIDIAN_VAULT_PATH; single-authority + pointers; merge = Done via line-anchored Fixes THR-XX in commit AND PR body.
